the-inner-chamber-month.title: भीतरी कोठरी में एक महीना
the-inner-chamber-month.description: प्रार्थना और वचन की एक दैनिक आदत बनाइए: एंड्रयू मरे के साथ छत्तीस भोर, हर दिन एक अध्याय।
note: Hindi's FIRST plan prose, shipping with the first Hindi books (queue jobs #690-#694). the-inner-chamber.hi is in this same PR, and it is the sole source book of this launch plan, so seed_plans creates the row on the next deploy — without an entry here the language would get no plan at all, which PlanTranslationCoverageTests fails on. This is the content of queue job #843.
The title opens with the shipped edition's own title verbatim (भीतरी कोठरी), as every other language's entry does, so the plan card and the book on the shelf agree.

school-of-prayer.title: प्रार्थना की पाठशाला
school-of-prayer.description: प्रार्थना की पाठशाला में चार सप्ताह, तीन मार्गदर्शकों के साथ: एंड्रयू मरे — प्रभु स्वयं हमें प्रार्थना करना कैसे सिखाते हैं; डी. एल. मूडी — प्रबल प्रार्थना; और हन्ना बुयिंज़ा — प्रार्थना, मसीही जीवन की दैनिक धड़कन।
note: Queue job #695. NONE of this curated plan's three source books (lord-teach-us-to-pray-2, prevailing-prayer, prayer-the-pulse-of-life) has a Hindi edition, so seed_plans creates no row today — this prose lands DORMANT on purpose. It exists so that whichever book lands last cannot publish an English-titled card in Hindi (the #819 defect). Same reasoning as the Spanish entry for this plan, job #517.

Names are transliterated, as all shipped Hindi content does: एंड्रयू मरे and डी. एल. मूडी follow the shipped Hindi corpus (12 and 3 occurrences). हन्ना बुयिंज़ा has NO Hindi precedent — this is the first Hindi content to name her, so a later prayer-the-pulse-of-life edition or bio should match this form rather than diverge. Note es/pt/sw/lg keep her name in Latin script; Hindi cannot, so it is transliterated here.

The three guides are named by AUTHOR, not by book title, because none of the three books ships in Hindi yet — there is no shipped title to quote. When they arrive, whoever translates them should either harmonise their titles with this card or adjust this entry in the same PR, exactly as the Arabic and Spanish notes ask.

deeper-life-in-christ.title: गहरा जीवन: मसीह तुम में
deeper-life-in-christ.description: अधिक परिश्रम नहीं, परन्तु एक व्यक्ति: गहरे जीवन का भेद यह है कि स्वयं मसीह भीतर वास करता है। एंड्रयू मरे “स्वयं यीशु” के अचम्भे से आरम्भ करते हैं, फिर भीतर वास करनेवाले जीवन को खोलते हैं, और हडसन टेलर प्रियतम के साथ मिलन और संगति के विश्राम में समाप्त करते हैं।
note: Queue job #696. Of this curated plan's three source books (jesus-himself-2, the-masters-indwelling, union-and-communion) only jesus-himself-2 has a Hindi edition, so seed_plans creates NO row today — this prose lands dormant on purpose, exactly as the Hindi school-of-prayer entry (#695) and the Arabic/Spanish entries for this same plan did. It exists so that whichever book lands last cannot publish an English-titled card in Hindi (the #819 defect).

“स्वयं यीशु” is the shipped Hindi edition's own title verbatim (jesus-himself-2.hi.json), quoted so the plan card and the book on the shelf agree — the same rule the Spanish (Jesús Mismo) and Swahili (Yesu Mwenyewe) entries follow. Hindi has no capitalisation, so quotation marks are what marks it as a title; the book's own description uses curly marks the same way.

«मसीह तुम में» is Colossians 1:27 as the shipped Hindi corpus already quotes it — himself.hi.json carries that exact short form six times, where Simpson hammers it. The IRV's full clause is «मसीह जो महिमा की आशा है तुम में रहता है»; the card quotes the short form the corpus uses, not a fresh rendering.

Vocabulary follows the shipped Hindi books rather than being coined here: भीतर वास for indwelling (35 occurrences), मिलन for union (80), संगति for communion (274), विश्राम for rest (144), भेद for the secret/mystery (209, and the IRV's own word at Col 1:27). एंड्रयू मरे is the shipped Hindi form of the author's name.

हडसन टेलर has NO Hindi precedent — this is the first Hindi content to name him, so a later union-and-communion edition or bio should match this form rather than diverge. Same situation as हन्ना बुयिंज़ा in the school-of-prayer entry.

The middle and closing phrases (भीतर वास करनेवाला जीवन, मिलन और संगति) are this entry's own renderings of the two untranslated books' motifs, not quotations of shipped titles. Whoever translates the-masters-indwelling or union-and-communion into Hindi should either harmonise its title with this card or adjust this entry in the same PR.

गहरा जीवन renders "the deeper life" with the positive adjective: Hindi has no idiomatic bare comparative for an attributive like this, and अधिक गहरा जीवन reads as a comparison to something named. The corpus offered no precedent (zero hits for any गहरा/गहन + जीवन collocation), so this is a fresh rendering.

humility-12-days.title: दीनता बारह दिनों में
humility-12-days.description: हर सद्गुण की जड़ पर एंड्रयू मरे की वह उत्कृष्ट पुस्तक — बारह दिनों तक, हर दिन एक छोटा अध्याय।
note: Queue job #1103, shipping in the SAME PR as humility-2.hi.json because it has to. humility-12-days is a LAUNCH plan with a single source book, so the moment the Hindi Humility lands, seed_plans creates the Hindi plan row on the next deploy — and without this entry it would publish the English card in Hindi, which is exactly the defect PR #819 shipped in Arabic. Verified against a seeded database: with this entry the row is created with the Hindi prose.
«दीनता» is the shipped Hindi edition's own title verbatim, so the plan card and the book it opens agree — the same rule the Spanish (Humildad) and Swahili (Unyenyekevu) entries follow.

«हर सद्गुण की जड़» is the phrase the Hindi book itself uses for 'the root of every virtue' (humility-2.hi ch01: «हर गुण की जड़», rendered here with सद्गुण to match the English card's 'virtue'), so the card quotes the edition rather than re-rendering the motif. एंड्रयू मरे is the shipped Hindi form of the author's name, the same one the-inner-chamber-month and deeper-life-in-christ use.

Digits: the title spells out बारह rather than using 12, unlike the Spanish and Portuguese cards. Hindi reads a bare numeral in a heading as a count rather than a span of days, and the description carries the number anyway; the Swahili and Luganda entries make the same choice in the description.

grace-for-every-sinner.title: परमेश्वर तक का मार्ग: हर पापी के लिये अनुग्रह
grace-for-every-sinner.description: जो सबसे पुराना सुसमाचार है, उस पर एक महीना। रिचर्ड बैक्सटर की उन लोगों के लिये कोमल पुकार जिनका मन अब तक नहीं फिरा, डी. एल. मूडी — परमेश्वर तक का मार्ग, और चार्ल्स स्पर्जन की सब कुछ अनुग्रह से — इसके सबसे सरल मार्गदर्शक कि पापी का उद्धार कैसे होता है, और उसे कैसे जाना जाए।
note: Queue job #1108. The title opens with the shipped edition's own title verbatim — परमेश्वर तक का मार्ग, from the-way-to-god.hi — so the plan card and the book on the shelf agree, as every other language's entry does. सब कुछ अनुग्रह से is likewise the shipped title of all-of-grace.hi.

seed_plans creates NO row today: a-call-to-the-unconverted has no Hindi edition, and a curated plan needs every source book present. This prose lands DORMANT on purpose, so that whichever book lands last cannot publish an English-titled card in Hindi (#819).

Names follow the shipped Hindi bios rather than being re-invented: रिचर्ड बैक्सटर (richard-baxter.html, 6 uses), डी. एल. मूडी (8 uses across the corpus), चार्ल्स स्पर्जन (the bio's full form is चार्ल्स हैडन स्पर्जन; the card uses the short form the English does).
"the unconverted" is rendered जिनका मन अब तक नहीं फिरा rather than a noun, keeping the मन फिराना root the corpus settled on for conversion (मन-फिराव, itself settled against the IRV's own मन फिराओ).

faith-in-the-fire.title: सब प्रकार की शान्ति का परमेश्वर: आग में विश्वास
faith-in-the-fire.description: उन दिनों के लिये जिनमें प्रार्थना करना कठिन हो जाता है। हन्ना व्हिटॉल स्मिथ — सब प्रकार की शान्ति का परमेश्वर, और गैरेथ इवांस — उसी पर भरोसा जो हमारा कल थामे हुए है: जब जीवन अनिश्चित हो, तब स्थिर शान्ति में पाँच सप्ताह की यात्रा।
note: Queue job #1444. the-god-of-all-comfort has NO Hindi edition, so unlike every other entry in this file the title could not quote a shipped book title. It is taken instead from the verse the title itself quotes — IRV 2 Corinthians 1:3, सब प्रकार की शान्ति का परमेश्वर — fetched byte-for-byte, which is the same wording the hannah-whitall-smith Hindi bio (job #1412, this same PR) independently chose for the book. Whoever translates that book should match this, or change both in one PR.
The second half echoes the shipped title of he-holds-my-tomorrows.hi, वह मेरा कल थामे हुए है, recast as जो हमारा कल थामे हुए है so the card's clause and the book's title agree.

seed_plans creates NO row today: he-holds-my-tomorrows.hi is shipped but the-god-of-all-comfort is not, so this curated plan's set is incomplete. Dormant on purpose. NOTE for whoever ships the-god-of-all-comfort in Hindi: that book COMPLETES this plan and will flip a five-week plan live on its deploy — it needs the plans/+page.ts prerender touch in the same PR, the #756 shape.

हन्ना व्हिटॉल स्मिथ is the form set by her Hindi bio in this same PR — हन्ना is the IRV's own form for Hannah (and runs 400 to 16 against हन्नाह in shipped Hindi content), व्हिटॉल takes its व्ह from the corpus's व्हाइटफ़ील्ड. गैरेथ इवांस is from gareth-evans.html.

power-from-on-high.title: ऊपर से सामर्थ्य: पवित्र आत्मा
power-from-on-high.description: आत्मा से भरे जीवन पर आर. ए. टॉरे के साथ चार सप्ताह: पहले पवित्र आत्मा से बपतिस्मा और वह सामर्थ्य जो वह सेवा के लिये देता है, फिर उस आत्मा के व्यक्तित्व और कार्य का गहरा अध्ययन जो हर विश्वासी में वास करता है।
note: Queue job #2141. Of this curated plan's two source books, only baptism-with-the-holy-spirit has a Hindi edition; the-person-and-work-of-the-holy-spirit does not. seed_plans needs every source book present, so it creates NO row today — this prose lands DORMANT on purpose, so that the second book cannot publish an English-titled card in Hindi (#819). NOTE for whoever ships the-person-and-work-of-the-holy-spirit in Hindi: that book COMPLETES this plan and will flip it live on its deploy.
«पवित्र आत्मा से बपतिस्मा» is the shipped edition's own title verbatim (baptism-with-the-holy-spirit.hi.json), quoted so the plan card and the book on the shelf agree.

The title «ऊपर से सामर्थ्य» renders 'power from on high' — the phrase of Luke 24:49. It is NOT claimed as a fetched verse (Take Root was unreachable this session); सामर्थ्य is the corpus's settled word for power and ऊपर से for 'from on high'. Confirm against the IRV when the second book lands.

आर. ए. टॉरे is the shipped Hindi form of the author's name (r-a-torrey short bio: रूबेन आर्चर टॉरे). वास is the corpus verb for the Spirit's indwelling (भीतर वास, 35 occurrences), here में वास करता है.

everything-for-christ.title: मसीह के लिये सब कुछ: उंडेला हुआ जीवन
everything-for-christ.description: पूरे मन का समर्पण किस मूल्य पर होता है, और उससे क्या मिलता है? डेविड ब्रेनर्ड की खोजपूर्ण मिशनरी डायरी, और उसके बाद उन स्त्री-पुरुषों की कहानियाँ जिन्होंने सुसमाचार के लिये अपना सब कुछ दे दिया — समर्पण का वह आह्वान, जो उत्तर देनेवाले जीवनों के द्वारा सुनाया गया है।
note: Queue job #2142. NEITHER source book (life-and-diary-of-david-brainerd, men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2) has a Hindi edition, so seed_plans creates NO row today — this prose lands DORMANT on purpose, so that whichever book lands last cannot publish an English-titled card in Hindi (#819).
डेविड ब्रेनर्ड is the settled Hindi form of the name (34 occurrences in the shipped Hindi corpus). समर्पण is the corpus word for surrender/consecration, सुसमाचार for the gospel.

The title is the plan's own name, not a book title, so nothing is quoted: «उंडेला हुआ जीवन» renders 'a life poured out' with the drink-offering image of 2 Tim 4:6 (उंडेला जाना). Whoever translates men-and-women-who-gave-everything-2 into Hindi should either harmonise its title with this card or adjust this entry in the same PR.

growing-in-wisdom-18-days.title: 18 दिनों में बुद्धि में बढ़ना
growing-in-wisdom-18-days.description: विद्यार्थियों के लिये जेम्स डीग्रीफ़ की मार्गदर्शिका — अठारह दिनों तक हर दिन एक छोटा पाठ। अपने उद्देश्य को खोजने से लेकर भविष्य का दर्शन गढ़ने तक, हर दिन व्यावहारिक सलाह के साथ पवित्रशास्त्र का एक वचन, एक मनन और एक प्रार्थना देता है।
note: Single-book LAUNCH plan backed by growing-in-wisdom.hi (job #2823), which makes it creatable in hi. The title takes the book's own hi title, «बुद्धि में बढ़ना»; «पवित्रशास्त्र», «मनन» and «प्रार्थना» are the book's settled words for Scripture, reflection and prayer.
«जेम्स डीग्रीफ़» is a fresh transliteration — the hi corpus had not spelled the author's name before. AI-drafted; awaiting native review.
